values.heading_2: Materials and micromanufacturing from one group
values.body_1:
With a long history of helping clients develop miniature products and bring them to market quickly, Potomac Photonics now combines its expertise with Goodfellow's work in materials science.

Goodfellow has supplied science and industry worldwide since 1946, contributing to projects from cochlear implants to the ignition of nuclear fusion. Its aim is to be a partner for every specialist material, designed, manufactured and delivered globally.

Together, Potomac's microfabrication and Goodfellow's materials expertise help accelerate product development across a wide range of industries.

Rapid turnaround on custom parts made from high-performance pressure-sensitive adhesives, from prototypes to production.

Pressure-sensitive adhesives are used across biotech, microfluidics, medical devices, electronics and aerospace. Goodfellow Microfabrication has developed a broad range of technologies to process them, for complex and simple parts on a prototyping or production basis.

Customers use these materials in applications such as microfluidics and medical devices, to bond layers together. Our laser technology covers cutting, patterning, layering and more.

Acrylic adhesivesSilicone adhesivesRubber-based adhesivesUV-curable adhesivesHot melt adhesivesConductive adhesivesBiomedical-grade adhesivesMulti-layer adhesive systemsCustom formulated adhesivesAnd many more

Precision laser cutting suits biotech and microfluidics, where accuracy and reliability matter: detailed microfluidic channels, multi-layer biomedical devices and precise bonding.

Tools to machine complex features in glass as small as 1 micron, with hole drilling, cutting and marking.

Glass is an amorphous solid, usually inorganic. Unlike crystalline solids it has no regular internal structure, and it is generally hard and brittle.

Using high-accuracy motion systems, Goodfellow Microfabrication holds tight positional tolerances across large parts, with line widths as narrow as 10 microns depending on the type of glass.

We have extensive experience drilling holes for leak testing of pharmaceutical vials and ampoules. See our leak test hole drilling capability.

Custom parts in DuPont Kapton polyimide, one of the most versatile materials for medical, biotech, aerospace, automotive and photovoltaics.

Goodfellow Microfabrication has micromachined Kapton polyimide films for over 30 years, fabricating complex and simple parts on a prototyping or production basis. Our technology machines all types of Kapton polyimide, including hole drilling, cutting and more.

We stock Kapton HN film in 0.001 in, 0.003 in and 0.005 in thicknesses for rapid turnaround on custom prototype parts.

values.body_1: A polyimide film developed by DuPont and used in consumer electronics, solar and wind energy, aerospace, automotive, medical devices and biotechnology. It has good insulation and temperature characteristics and comes in many types, sizes and thicknesses. Goodfellow Microfabrication carries Kapton HN and VN on the shelf and can turn around custom parts in as little as 24 hours in some cases.
values.body_2: Polyether ether ketone is a colourless thermoplastic used in medical, biotech, aerospace and automotive applications. It has high tensile strength, a wide temperature range and strong wear resistance. Goodfellow Microfabrication has extensive experience fabricating precision PEEK parts, such as microfluidic devices and complex automotive parts.
values.body_3: One of the most widely used thermoplastics: durable, scratch resistant and inexpensive. Also known as Lexan, Makroclear and Makrolon, it is used in automotive, defence, medical device, biotech, electronics and alternative energy.
values.body_4: Biaxially-oriented polyethylene terephthalate is a polyester film used in biotech, electrical and packaging applications. Also known as Hostaphan, Melinex and Mylar, it can be metallised with conductive coatings such as ITO and patterned by Goodfellow Microfabrication.
values.body_5: Also known as polyamide, nylon is a durable synthetic polymer available in many configurations. Goodfellow Microfabrication has machined precision features in nylon, including blind channels in nylon rods for a medical device application.
values.body_6: Acrylonitrile butadiene styrene is a tough thermoplastic with good heat resistance, used for mechanical parts and components and available in many types and colours. Alongside machining complex ABS parts, Goodfellow Microfabrication can laser mark ABS quickly and cost-effectively.
values.body_7: Goodfellow Microfabrication stocks a wide range of these polymers. If a material is not in stock, we can source it quickly from our network of qualified suppliers. There is no minimum order quantity. Related: Polymers · Kapton

Highly precise, extremely small features across all types and thicknesses of stainless steel.

Stainless steels are iron-based alloys containing at least 10.5% chromium. A thin, dense chromium oxide film forms on the surface, providing corrosion resistance and preventing further oxidation.

There are five types of stainless steel, which differ with their other alloying additions and range from fully austenitic to fully ferritic.

  • Welding of stainless steel components
